entries.mechanism: strip sampler：每 reel 独立均匀抽取一个合法 stop，再依 strip 顺序取连续窗口，越过 strip 尾部时循环；不是对可见 cells 独立抽 symbol。
entries.reason: 连续窗口保留 strip 内相关性，是必须讲授的服务端分布规则；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Draw one independent uniform stop per reel, read consecutive strip positions with wraparound, and verify joint window frequencies rather than treating visible cells as independent symbol draws.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop FG 的独占全 wild 补奖：先排除本轮已支付普通 ways 的 symbol，再按左起全 wild 连续 reels 的 wild 数乘积，向每个剩余 symbol 分别支付对应 paytable；两 reel 情形只允许指定最高 symbol。
entries.reason: 全 wild 补奖的排除集合与 ways 计数直接决定现金；新技能定位：全 wild、多连通组和实现偏差需要明确的现金评估规则，math-lines-ways-cluster 仅剩 1 词。
entries.rule: ToTheTop pays all-wild prefix ways separately for every otherwise-unpaid ordinary symbol, using the product of wild counts; restrict two-reel awards to the designated top symbol and verify exclusions.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop 自然 base 分别按 coin 数触发 coin feature、按恰好达到 scatter 数触发 FG；两条件并非互斥，两 feature 奖励与 base line win 相加。
entries.reason: 两个不互斥的 feature 及恰好命中条件决定触发与付款；新技能定位：免费局触发优先级、共享隐藏状态和跨局升级需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能仅剩 2 词。
entries.rule: Evaluate coin-count and exact scatter-count triggers independently, add both qualifying features to base line winnings, and verify simultaneous triggers plus scatter counts above the exact threshold.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop FG 的 reel 增高：每个尚未满高 reel 的 growth coin 立即解锁同一 strip window 的下一格并增加一场 FG，新揭露的 growth coin 可以在同一 spin 连续增高；满高后 growth coin 变成 wild，不再加场。
entries.reason: 解锁生效时点和递归增高改变免费局长度与分布。
entries.rule: Each growth coin below maximum height reveals the next position of the same strip window and awards a free spin, recursively processing newly exposed growth coins; maximum-height growth coins become wilds, verifying both boundaries.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop stacked FG route 按累计额外授予 FG 数选择下一 spin 的 reel set，而不是按已播放 spin 数、当前中奖次数或固定每 spin 改一次 reel。
entries.reason: 按授予而非播放计数选择 reel set 是可转移的状态索引规则；新技能定位：免费局触发优先级、共享隐藏状态和跨局升级需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能仅剩 2 词。
entries.rule: Select the next stacked free-spin reel set using cumulative additional spins awarded, not spins played or wins, and verify that multiple awards and award-free spins preserve the intended index.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop coin feature 的本 reel 落币率在该 reel 的本次 respin 开始按旧 occupancy 固定，同 reel 较早 landing 不改变后续格的概率；Disco 则在扫描每个空格前重新按当前 reel occupancy 计算 rate，形成同 spin 内反馈。 Gold Rush 也使用 Disco 的逐 cell occupancy 更新顺序。
entries.reason: 同一 respin 内是否反馈 occupancy 改变转移概率。
entries.rule: Freeze ToTheTop landing odds at pre-respin reel occupancy; recompute Gold/Disco odds before each empty cell using updated occupancy, and verify draw order with multiple same-reel landings.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop 与 Maneater 的 FG 最低奖以整段 feature 反复重生成实现（未加新 stake、无 retry budget）；自然/买入可用不同下界；Maneater 自然 FG 到 upper band 还会按概率拒绝并继续同一循环；ToTheTop 某些 variant 在 feature 生成前随机把该下界上调一次。
entries.reason: 整段拒绝采样、上界过滤和一次性随机下界需要计入 RTP。
entries.rule: Retain entry and hidden state; regenerate complete free features without extra stake until route-specific minimum-pay and upper-band tests pass, sampling threshold uplift once; verify positive acceptance, termination and conditioned RTP.

entries.mechanism: ToTheTop 部分普通 RTP variant 先按独立概率选择 whole-round zero-win 条件，再不断重新生成完整 main round（含 FG/coin feature）直到 round.win 为零；该路由不追加 stake。
entries.reason: 整轮 forced-zero 条件化改变含 feature 的分布。
entries.rule: Sample the forced-zero gate once, regenerate complete main rounds including every feature until total winnings are zero, charge no additional stake, and verify acceptance probability plus resulting RTP.

entries.mechanism: Maneater 在 trigger spin 的指定 reels 上只有 stack 起点位于指定边时才抽对应 local jackpot；每符合 reel 单独抽一次、中奖支付配置 fixed jackpot×inner stake，respin 和 FG 不再抽这个 local jackpot。
entries.reason: 固定 jackpot 的触发几何、抽数与 stake basis 是经济规则。
entries.rule: On the trigger spin only, independently test each eligible edge-aligned stack reel for its local jackpot and pay configured jackpot times inner stake; verify that respins and free games make no such draws.

entries.mechanism: Maneater conversion 先按 eligible symbol 总数与 stack count/phase 抽要转换的数量，再无放回均匀选对应 symbol 位置；base trigger 倍率固定，base respin 与 FG 各自重新抽 baby-wild 倍率。
entries.reason: 转换数量、位置和倍率的联合抽样规则可用于同类转换 feature；新技能定位：保留身份、类型限制、路径与终止边界需要补充，现有 moving-wild 技能只有 75 词余量。
entries.rule: Sample conversion count conditional on eligible-symbol count, stacks and phase, choose positions uniformly without replacement, and use fixed trigger versus freshly sampled respin/free-game baby-wild multipliers, verifying phase-specific distributions.

entries.mechanism: Maneater fg300 总买入先在不同 initial-scatter award routes 中等概率抽一个，再按被选 route 生成 feature 与最低奖过滤；直接 fg303/304/305 routes 使用同成本但指定该入口。
entries.reason: 入口混合在过滤之前确定，不能用自然分布或重新抽入口替代；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。
entries.rule: The mixed fg300 buy chooses its entry-scatter route uniformly once, then applies that route’s feature and minimum-pay filter; direct routes fix entry at the same cost, verifying route mix and RTP separately.

entries.mechanism: Disco base 左边 multiplier scatter 与右边 gold collector 同时出现才触发 one-shot：保留所有 coin/special，非 coin 清为空格，按原 coin 数对空格追加 regular coins，先把 regular 值乘左侧倍率，再把所有 regular coin 值一次汇入 gold 并支付；既存 regular 的乘后值带入自然 bonus。
entries.reason: one-shot 收集顺序和带入 bonus 的数值决定双阶段付款；新技能定位：一次收集、复制收集和倍率自值决定实际支付，math-hold-and-win 的 42 词余量无法容纳全部规则。
entries.rule: Disco requires both edge specials, retains coins, refills blanks using original coin count, multiplies regular values before one gold sweep, and carries those regular values into bonus; verify one payment and preserved trigger eligibility.

entries.mechanism: Disco gold 买入先抽固定 entry 的 coin 数/stop vector/coin values，然后保持该 entry 重放整段 bonus 直到至少落过一个 gold collector；普通 disco buy 不执行此条件化。
entries.reason: 固定 entry 的 feature 条件化与普通买入有不同分布。
entries.rule: For Disco gold buys, sample entry count, stops and values once, regenerate the bonus until a gold lands, and verify retry termination and entry isolation; ordinary Disco buys do not condition on gold.

entries.mechanism: Book/Chili 的前导 wild 后出现普通符号时，以该普通符号支付整条连续 run；不会再比较较短 pure-wild 前缀的支付；整条仅 wild 时才以 wild 支付。
entries.reason: 前导 wild 的支付身份政策必须明确，不能默认取最大支付；新技能定位：全 wild、多连通组和实现偏差需要明确的现金评估规则，math-lines-ways-cluster 仅剩 1 词。
entries.rule: For Book/Chili and Nudge lines, the first ordinary symbol determines payment after leading wilds; pay the wild table only for an entirely wild run, and verify shorter pure-wild prefixes are never compared or added.

entries.mechanism: Gold 的 Nugget Collect 以 reel-5 Collector 与至少一枚原始 Nugget 共现触发；不要求 reel-1 Multiplier 共现。
entries.reason: 收集触发不依赖倍率符号，是独立的 feature 门；新技能定位：一次收集、复制收集和倍率自值决定实际支付，math-hold-and-win 的 42 词余量无法容纳全部规则。
entries.rule: Trigger Nugget Collect when reel-five Collector coexists with at least one original Nugget, without requiring reel-one Multiplier, and verify collector-only, multiplier-only and combined-special boards.

entries.mechanism: Nugget Collect 保留 Nugget/初始 specials，清除其余 cells；每个 empty cell 只重抽一次 Nugget landing，landing odds 以原始 Nugget 数量索引并向末项饱和，不随本次新 coin 递增。
entries.reason: 固定起始数量的 one-shot refill 与动态 occupancy 不是同一过程；新技能定位：一次收集、复制收集和倍率自值决定实际支付，math-hold-and-win 的 42 词余量无法容纳全部规则。
entries.rule: Retain original coins and specials, clear other cells, and test each blank once using original Nugget-count odds saturated at the last entry; verify new landings do not update that probability index.

entries.mechanism: Nugget Collect 的可选初始 Multiplier 只乘所有 regular Nugget values；Collector 取 regular 总和并支付一份，line win 另加，Collector 自身不再加入 coin 池。
entries.reason: regular-only 倍率、源池与支付一次的约束改变金额；新技能定位：一次收集、复制收集和倍率自值决定实际支付，math-hold-and-win 的 42 词余量无法容纳全部规则。
entries.rule: Multiply regular Nuggets only when the initial Multiplier exists, pay their sum once through Collector alongside line wins, and exclude Collector itself from the coin pool, verifying simultaneous line and collection rewards.

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco bonus entry 仅 regular coins 紧密装入各 reel 底部，初始可玩窗口外每枚 entry coin 再解锁一格；以后每枚新 coin 在本轮 landing 完毕后解锁本 reel 一格，effect/payment 后 coins 再紧密下落，下一 respin 才能使用新开空格。
entries.reason: bonus 初板重排与延迟解锁属于可复用扩展 reel 状态机。
entries.rule: Pack regular entry coins into reel bottoms, unlock extra entry height, then apply landing unlocks after scanning and compact after effects; new space is usable next respin, verifying entry and subsequent unlock boundaries.

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco 同 bonus respin 生成特殊币的限制：落过 multiplier/gold 后清零其后对应 type 权重；每 reel silver 也有生成限制，Gold 用显式 null 检查、Disco 用 row truthiness（row zero 不能阻止后续 silver）；Gold 无可用 type 权重时 fallback regular。
entries.reason: 同轮类型限额、row-zero 差异和零权重 fallback 改变实际分布；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: Suppress later multiplier/gold types after one lands and limit silver per reel, with Gold’s null guard versus Disco’s row-truthiness behavior; Gold falls back to regular on zero weights, verifying row zero and exhaustion.

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco bonus Multiplier coin 将全部已有/新 coin values 乘 m，随后自身 value 恢复为 m 而非 m²；它自身的 m 也进入终盘支付。
entries.reason: 倍率币自身也支付，必须避免对自身平方；新技能定位：一次收集、复制收集和倍率自值决定实际支付，math-hold-and-win 的 42 词余量无法容纳全部规则。
entries.rule: A multiplier coin multiplies every occupied coin value by m, then resets its own value to m rather than m²; include its value in final payment and verify old/new coins plus self-value.

entries.mechanism: Gold/Disco bonus Gold collector 由初值零复制全盘 coin 总和，Silver 由初值零复制本 reel 总和；sources 不消耗，copy 另留 board，special 下一轮转 regular 后保留值并能再被放大/收集；Disco row-zero skip 另有已教条目。
entries.reason: 复制收集保留源与副本，会改变后续奖励复利；新技能定位：一次收集、复制收集和倍率自值决定实际支付，math-hold-and-win 的 42 词余量无法容纳全部规则。
entries.rule: Gold copies the whole-board sum and Silver its reel sum from zero without consuming sources, retains the copy, and becomes regular next respin; verify source-plus-copy payment and subsequent multiplication or recollection.

entries.mechanism: Gold 买入先抽 entry Nugget count，再按 count 条件抽全三枚 Nugget-stack reels 的 pattern；每 reel 从合法 stack/blank stop 列表均匀抽 stop，value 按 main base weights；entry 不支付 line/collection。
entries.reason: 买入入口的条件式 board 生成和零入口支付必须单独定价。
entries.rule: For Gold buys, draw entry coin count, condition the stack-reel pattern on it, sample legal stack/blank stops uniformly, and use base coin-value weights without entry line/collection payment, verifying the joint entry law.

entries.mechanism: goldBonus 固定一份已抽 entry board，整段 Gold Rush 重抽直到至少出现一枚 Gold，最多固定 attempts；bonus 不重抽；exhaustion 返回最后一次即使无 Gold。
entries.reason: 有限 attempts 的最后候选 fallback 不是无限保证。
entries.rule: For Gold goldBonus, keep one independently cloned entry board and retry the bonus within its fixed attempt budget until Gold appears; return the last attempt on exhaustion, verifying nongold fallback and RTP.

entries.mechanism: Book 的同一 Book 符号既作为 line wild 替代普通符号，也按原始全盘数量付 scatter 奖并触发/retrigger feature；line 与 scatter 奖金分别累加。
entries.reason: wild 与 scatter 双角色及原盘计数决定支付和触发；新技能定位：全 wild、多连通组和实现偏差需要明确的现金评估规则，math-lines-ways-cluster 仅剩 1 词。
entries.rule: Treat Book as both line wild and original-board scatter, independently adding scatter cash and trigger/retrigger eligibility to line awards, and verify that substitution or expansion does not change the counted scatter population.

entries.mechanism: Book 原盘 Scatter 达 threshold 进入一组免费 spins；FG 中再次达 threshold 增加同组 rounds；免费轮使用独立 fg strip 而非 base strip。
entries.reason: 免费局入口、追加轮与独立 strip 是标准 slot feature 机制；新技能定位：免费局触发优先级、共享隐藏状态和跨局升级需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能仅剩 2 词。
entries.rule: Threshold scatters award a free-spin group, qualifying free-spin scatters add rounds to that same group, and all free spins use the free-game strips; verify entry, retriggers and base-versus-feature strip selection.

entries.mechanism: Book 免费 spins 开始前按 weights 只选一次 ordinary symbol，整段含 retriggers 使用同一 expansion identity；每轮该 symbol 所在 reel 全高变成该 symbol，Book wild 不替代它触发 expansion。
entries.reason: 单次选定扩展 identity 及真符号匹配规则可复用。
entries.rule: Choose one weighted ordinary expansion symbol at feature entry and retain it through retriggers; expand every reel containing that actual symbol, never wild substitutes, and verify stable identity plus separated-reel awards.

entries.mechanism: Burning Scatter 不替代普通 line，遇到即截断 line；全盘 Scatter 按 count 给一笔额外 scatter pay，line 与 scatter 合计，未触发免费或 coin game。
entries.reason: scatter 的 line 阻断、额外现金和无 feature 是明确的 evaluator 政策；新技能定位：全 wild、多连通组和实现偏差需要明确的现金评估规则，math-lines-ways-cluster 仅剩 1 词。
entries.rule: Burning scatters terminate ordinary line runs without substituting, while original-board scatter count adds a separate cash award and triggers no feature; verify line interruption, additive awards and absence of free-spin transitions.

entries.mechanism: Disco96 gold 买入的无 Gold 重试不重新复制 seed coin 对象：失败 feature 内 multiplier 对 seed regular values 的修改留到下次尝试，下一次 accepted feature 的付款因此依赖先前被拒绝路径。
entries.reason: 代码确认失败路径会修改重试 seed，作为拒绝采样隔离的金额风险应讲授。
entries.rule: Disco96 retries alias entry coin objects, so rejected multipliers can increase later accepted payouts; reproduce this dependency when auditing legacy RTP and verify deep-copy isolation before adopting independent rejection sampling.

entries.mechanism: 每个动作使用对应的 private reel strip；各 reel 独立抽取 stop，并按 strip 循环取连续窗口；respin 切换到对应 Respin strip。
entries.reason: 此项额外规定 action 与 respin strip 切换，不是纯抽样重复项；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Select private strips by action and switch to the designated respin strips; draw independent uniform reel stops with circular contiguous windows, verifying phase selection and correlated windows.

entries.mechanism: payline 的第一个普通 paying symbol 固定 winningSymbol，前后 wild 均作为该 symbol 延长 run；只有整段为 wild 时才按 WILD paytable 付款，不另比较或支付较短纯 wild 前缀。
entries.reason: 普通符号确定 run 身份及仅全 wild 用 wild 表的规则已由更集中证据的 s01#13 覆盖。

entries.mechanism: 只有 gold wild 进入保留板并参与 feature 触发：多个 gold wild 达到触发条件，或 gold wild 与 ARROW 同盘即触发；normal wild 既不保留也不计入该组合触发。
entries.reason: 角色区分同时约束保留与触发，不能把所有 wild 等同；新技能定位：保留身份、类型限制、路径与终止边界需要补充，现有 moving-wild 技能只有 75 词余量。
entries.rule: Retain and count only gold wilds: qualifying multiple golds or gold-plus-ARROW trigger the feature; normal wilds neither persist nor trigger, verifying mixed-role boards and ARROW without gold.

entries.mechanism: trigger spin 上 normal/gold wild 的 multiplier 均为 1；只有后续 respin 新落且未被保留 wild 覆盖的 gold wild 才按当前 mode 和 totalPaylines 抽 multiplier，随后保留该值；normal wild 始终为 1。
entries.reason: 倍率资格依赖 phase 与覆盖状态，影响支付与保留；新技能定位：保留身份、类型限制、路径与终止边界需要补充，现有 moving-wild 技能只有 75 词余量。
entries.rule: Trigger-spin wilds have multiplier one; only uncovered new gold wilds in later respins sample the mode/payline-dependent multiplier and retain it, while normal wilds remain one, verifying covered landings and persistence.

entries.mechanism: ARROW 不改变当前付款盘：它将每一 reel 的保留 gold wild 按原垂直顺序紧密排列到该 reel 顶部，保留各自 multiplier，作为下一 respin 保留板；没有保留 gold wild 时 ARROW 不会产生该 reset。
entries.reason: RESET 的支付后生效与稳定重排补足现有 nudge 规则。
entries.rule: After paying the current board, ARROW compacts retained gold wilds to reel tops in original vertical order with multipliers unchanged; use that board next respin and verify no reset without retained gold.

entries.mechanism: fruitNudge100k 的低 stake main20/main40 在 organic generator 之前额外抽一次稀有分支；命中即返回按 stake 缩放 WIN_FIELDS 指定的金额字段的预存 max-win 轨迹并支付 floor，绕过当轮 reel/feature 生成及 organic cap rejection。
entries.reason: 前置稀有 gate、预置轨迹金额字段缩放及 floor 支付重复证据更完整的 s03#11，action/stake/phase 差异由 canonical 的 eligibility 核对保留。

entries.mechanism: payline 明细逐条 normalize 后舍入；权威 totalPaylineWin 则先加未归一化 lineWin，再以 inner bet / totalPaylines 归一化并整体舍入，而非加明细舍入值。respin 按该盘权威金额累计，whole-round 再舍入/封顶，因此明细之和未必等于实付。
entries.reason: 明细舍入和权威支付舍入位置不同，需要明确核对。
entries.rule: Round each normalized line descriptor separately, but round authoritative payment after summing raw line awards and applying inner-bet/payline normalization; accumulate authoritative respin payments, then round/cap the round, verifying display-sum discrepancies.

entries.mechanism: 每卷独立均匀抽取本卷 strip stop，再按同一 stop 取循环连续窗口；strip 内符号因连续窗口相关，而非逐格独立抽样。前两卷居中对齐共同坐标，卷面 sizes 属配置。
entries.reason: 独立均匀 stop 与循环连续窗口重复 s01#0，附带卷面尺寸和居中对齐属于配置。

entries.mechanism: 连通评估以相邻卷同一行或上下相邻一行连接：第 1 卷仅要求右邻，第 2 卷要求左右邻，此后只要求已连通左邻；Bar/Treasure 分支不做 backward-prune，不能通往最末支付卷的早期分支仍进入每卷计数乘积和最高 wild 选择。
entries.reason: 连通构造与不反向剪枝直接改变 ways 和倍率；新技能定位：全 wild、多连通组和实现偏差需要明确的现金评估规则，math-lines-ways-cluster 仅剩 1 词。
entries.rule: Bar/Treasure connect adjacent reels at row offsets −1,0,1, seed using the first-two-reel neighbor rules, and retain forward dead-end branches when multiplying counts and selecting maximum wild; verify against backward-pruned fixtures.

entries.mechanism: 跨相邻卷只允许同排及上下相邻排连接；当前两卷上、下分支均存在，且前三卷中间行断开时，从两个起点分别扩展两个 connected group；每组独立算长度、ways 乘积和最高 wild，再相加，后段共享位置仍可分别属于两组。Bar/Treasure 不剪枝，Piggy 分组后剪枝，另列差异。

entries.mechanism: 每个 coin 的价值表由其所在原始 strip 窗口是否恰有一个 coin 决定；同卷多 coin 切换 stacked table。此判定发生在 retained-wild 覆盖前，覆盖 coin 虽不收集仍影响本卷价值分布。
entries.reason: 被覆盖 coin 仍决定面值分布，是不能删除的条件抽样依赖；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。

entries.mechanism: moving refill 时，若该卷任意位置已有 retained wild，该卷所有新 strip WILD 的类型都强制 normal；仅完全无 retained wild 的卷才随机成为新 gold，且被 retained 位置覆盖的 landing 不计新 arrival。

entries.rule: If any retained wild occupies a reel, every new strip wild there is forced normal; only empty-retention reels can generate gold, and covered landings are not arrivals, verifying whole-reel suppression.

entries.mechanism: moving 新 wild 的类型权重表按 action/当前 feature spin 选择并在最后行饱和；当次新 gold 使用进入该 respin 前的 future-tier index。每个含新 gold 的 respin 结算后，只把未来新 gold 的 multiplier index 升一档至 tier cap；多个同次 arrival 不累计多档，既有 gold 倍数不升级。

entries.rule: Sample new-wild types by action/spin with last-row saturation; arrivals use the pre-respin future tier, and any new-gold spin advances that tier once for future arrivals only, verifying multiple arrivals and unchanged survivors.

entries.reason: feature 终止边界与入口资格不同于 nudge cleanup；新技能定位：保留身份、类型限制、路径与终止边界需要补充，现有 moving-wild 技能只有 75 词余量。
entries.rule: Reset moving-feature state at entry, extend its horizon from the leftmost new gold, and stop after gold reaches the rightmost reel without an exit-only cleanup; verify Piggy’s noncollecting two-gold eligibility.

entries.mechanism: random-jump 新 gold 在前两卷各至多采用一个路径；第 1 卷先按 spin-dependent table 选 pattern，第 2 卷反复拒绝同 pattern 和仅末步不同的 paired patterns。逐步取路径目标卷并均匀选目标行；若目标卷未变，拒绝原行，强制 gold 改变格子。

entries.mechanism: 两种 selectable free-game 模式的 retrigger law 不同：moving FG 每个 trigger spin 按 scatter reward table 重触发，randomJump FG 只用入口 scatter 的初始 rounds，所有后续 roundReward 固定零；各 round 中 moving/jumping respin 的 scatter 不增加 FG rounds。

entries.mechanism: random-jump 在最长剩余路径已变为零时，若当前 refill 又落下新 gold wild，强制将 spinsLeft 改为 1，下一 respin 才给该新 gold 分配跳跃路径；此新 arrival 会延长 feature 而非直接进入 cleanup。

entries.mechanism: AATF/Perseus 的 ways evaluator 对连续全 wild 前缀，为尚未形成实符号 win 的每一种普通 symbol 另算一笔该 symbol 的 paytable 奖励；Perseus 这些 ways 只用于 chest/bomb 判定而非直接现金。

entries.mechanism: AATF 的 fork 与 knife wild 合起来或单个双角色 wild 触发收鱼 respin；触发时 initial ways 只记录，不计入现金，实际支付 expanded respin 的 ways 和 fish。

entries.mechanism: AATF 收鱼 respin 冻结前两整列，后面三列重取 strip 并扩高；自然 base 抽 expansion height，FG 每次收鱼令这三列高度增加一级并在后续免费局持续保留至上限。

entries.mechanism: AATF 无 Elvis 的收鱼 respin 直接支付该 expanded board 上全部 fish face×stake，并与该 respin ways 相加；未触发收鱼的普通局不单独支付鱼值。

entries.rule: AATF buys reuse one uniform draw for entry-scatter selection and one-shot band replay, retaining the selected model without rechecking replacement; Elvis buys condition base on fork-plus-knife with option fixed, verifying correlations and RTP.

entries.mechanism: Perseus/Cetus 只有 initial payline win 才开启整列 continuation；每个后续 winning wave 按 wave-dependent weights 在前四列选开槽，槽右侧整列右移、最右列退出，槽内重新填连续三格。

entries.mechanism: Perseus 开槽抽 Regular/Kraken/Chest/Bomb：Kraken 将槽整列替换成 1× wild；Cetus 两个 SKU 仅 Regular/Kraken，整列三个 wild 共享一次 wave-dependent cetus multiplier 抽样，下一 wave 重置旧倍率为 1。

entries.rule: Perseus slots choose Regular/Kraken/Chest/Bomb, with Kraken becoming a one-times wild reel; Cetus permits Regular/Kraken and shares one sampled multiplier across its three wilds, resetting old multipliers next wave, verifying mode and lifetime.

entries.mechanism: Perseus Chest 先填一列普通 strip，再随机覆盖一格 1× chest wild；对所有非 pure-wild ways wins，按每种 win 的 non-wild 可见格数查 chestValues 并累加，即使 receiver 不在该 win 中；pure-wild fallback 不收增量。

entries.rule: Place a zero-balance chest wild into a regular filled reel, then add chestValues indexed by nonwild visible cells for every non-pure-wild ways win even without receiver participation; verify pure-wild exclusion and overlapping-win increments.

entries.mechanism: Perseus Bomb 先用 strip 填槽并随机放一个 bomb wild；ways 判断赢格后保留全部赢格，炸掉其他格、压实保留格并按列 strip 补空；槽中 object wild 转普通 wild，最后重新计算 paylines 才付钱。

entries.rule: Bomb inserts a wild, preserves ways-winning cells, removes others, compacts and strip-refills each reel, converts object wilds to ordinary wilds, then pays reevaluated paylines; verify preserved cells and absence of direct ways cash.

entries.mechanism: Perseus/Cetus 的 forceNonWin 门使开槽仅可选前两列并强制 Regular；若余下前三区两列均有 wild，则放弃强制；否则至多 strip.length 次找不含保留列普通符号及 wild 的连续三格，失败 fallback 一次正常 spin。

entries.mechanism: Perseus FG 根据触发 3/4/5 scatter 数抽一份可用角色组合：5 scatter 强制全角色；后续 initial board 的 4/5 scatter 可从单角色升级到双/全角色，并永久改变后续 wave 的角色概率表。

entries.mechanism: Perseus/Cetus 自然 FG 门只看被接受的 initial base board 的 scatter；FG initial board 的 scatter 独立增加 unmultiplied scatter cash 和 retrigger spins，continuation 新生成 scatter 不另触发；FG 初始 round 数是按 action/entry scatter 加权抽样。
entries.reason: scatter 奖、retrigger 与初始抽轮共同限定 feature 状态；新技能定位：免费局触发优先级、共享隐藏状态和跨局升级需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能仅剩 2 词。

entries.mechanism: cetusOnly 与 perseusCetusOnly 买 FG 同一 entry scatter cash 计入 synthetic base.win 后，又被 loadFreeGames 放进 freeGame.winning，最终两者相加；natural FG 则仅 feature 入口计一次。
entries.reason: 两层累计已确认重含同一 scatter cash，应作为路线计价偏差讲授；新技能定位：分组舍入、增量信用和多阶段 cap 必须单独讲授，现有 paytable 与 buy 技能余量不足。

entries.mechanism: 按每列 strip 长度独立均匀抽 stop，再沿 strip 连续取可见窗口并循环回绕；列内可见符号相关，不能按每格独立 weighted draw 替代。

entries.mechanism: Tartarus/Medusa/Zeus 开局每 reel 可均匀选一个位置注入 model 指定 wild/scatter；Sweety Treaty base 开局仅有 scatter injection，FG 开局才可注入 wild；tumble 仅替换本波新补 vacant，留存 special 的 reel 不再注入，tier 随 action/wave 选定。

entries.mechanism: Sweety Treaty base 每波为各 reel 宣告 multiplier，只有本波实际注入 wild 的 reel 激活；本 wave 奖乘 active values 之和，无 active 为 1；首个 base wave 不激活 multiplier。
entries.reason: announced 倍率不自动有效，base 首波另有禁用门；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: Sweety Treaty base pays with the sum of announced multipliers only on reels receiving a wild that wave, defaults to one when none activate, and disables activation on the first wave, verifying announcements without landings.

entries.mechanism: latent forced-dead model 保留已抽 model/action，反复生成 opening board 直到 OAK cash win 为零，再接收该 board 的 scatter；opening rejection 没有 fixed retry budget。

entries.rule: Keep the chosen model/action fixed and redraw opening boards until OAK cash is zero, then retain accepted scatters, with no retry budget or added stake; verify accepted scatter distribution and termination.

entries.mechanism: Rush latent branch 二次抽 featureModel 与较高 multiplier 起档；FG 在 persistent floor 上叠加临时 offset 后当前 spin 逐 winning wave 上升，临时跳档不写回跨 spin floor。
entries.reason: 临时 offset 与跨 spin floor 必须分开建模；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。

entries.mechanism: Rush FG 的 terminal scatter 达条件后 persistent 起档只升一档并封顶，供下一 spin 使用；当前 spin 已付奖及临时 Rush 起档不重算，scatter 可另行 retrigger。
entries.reason: scatter floor 升级只影响下一 spin，不能追溯改奖；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: Qualifying terminal scatters raise Rush’s persistent starting index once up to the ladder cap for the next spin, without repricing current wins; separately award retriggers and verify multiple scatters plus temporary-offset reset.

entries.mechanism: Chase 每个 positive winning wave 先按当前档付款，再检查 pre-downgrade wild：Tartarus/Medusa 要对应 FG 的确切 tier，Zeus 允许对应或更高 tier，bronze 允许任意 wild；无论几枚 qualifying wild 都只升一档并跨 spin 保留。
entries.reason: advance 门依赖当前 award 及降级前 tier，各游戏资格不同；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: Pay each positive Chase wave at its current tier, then advance once using pre-downgrade wilds: Tartarus/Medusa require exact tier, Zeus allows at-least tier, bronze any wild; verify multiwild and cross-spin carry.

entries.mechanism: Chase 内嵌 Rush 用 min(persistent index + temporary offset, ladder end)；qualifying wild 后 persistent index 加一，再重算 temporary index；spin 结束丢弃 offset，不按 waveCount 自动爬档。
entries.reason: Chase 内嵌 Rush 的临时和永久升级有不同生命周期；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: Within Chase-Rush, use min(persistent index+temporary offset,last rung), increment persistent index only after qualifying wilds, and recompute the temporary index; discard offset at spin end, verifying no wave-count-driven upgrades.

entries.mechanism: FG 条件 model law：Rush 的 model odds 按 initial scatter count 选行，Chase 按 current persistent multiplier index 选行；boosted 六-scatter entry 另启专用 model odds 和 wild-injection probability。
entries.reason: 抽样表由有经济意义的状态选择，不能平均化为配置列表；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: Select Rush model odds by entry scatter count and Chase odds by current persistent index; boosted six-scatter entry uses separate model and injection tables, verifying all conditional selectors and cross-spin updates.

entries.mechanism: Chase 才另付 trigger scatter cash 和每个 FG spin 的 terminal scatter cash；scatter cash 在 wave ladder 奖之外添加，不乘 wave multiplier；Rush 不获得这些 scatter cash。
entries.reason: scatter cash 的资格与倍率豁免改变实际现金；新技能定位：分组舍入、增量信用和多阶段 cap 必须单独讲授，现有 paytable 与 buy 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Chase adds trigger and terminal free-spin scatter cash outside wave-ladder multiplication, while Rush pays neither scatter-cash component; verify route-specific totals and unchanged scatter awards under high wave multipliers.

entries.mechanism: Medusa regular/super scatter 合计触发 entry，super count 另决定 Rush/Chase 初始 persistent ladder index；只有 base/boost scatter injection 抽 super 类型，FG injection 仅 regular；superfg3 buy 固定四 entry scatter、三个 super 并直接开放 Rush。

entries.mechanism: Zeus cascade-stop/pre-top-rung kill 仅在 guard armed 且 refill 有奖时抽 rejection；先命中一个 guard 后不再抽另一个；从同一 accepted gravity 继续推进 cursor，有限次寻找真实 dead board，耗尽仍保留真实中奖并继续 cascade。

entries.mechanism: Blood Moon 新格先抽 scatter；未中 scatter 才以 unconditional orb probability / (1 - scatterChance) 的 conditional rate 抽 FG-only orb并限界，剩余抽 ordinary weighted symbol；base 永不生成 orb。

entries.rule: For super buys, scale orb landing probability and sample values from the minimum-eligible ladder entries with retained weights renormalized; verify lower values disappear rather than accumulate mass at the minimum.

entries.mechanism: Tartarus Stream 自然 continuation 将整个 capped base + chosen feature 再作为 response.win 返回，opening 已付 base，但 continuation 没有减去已付 base。

entries.mechanism: 逐列加权抽 symbol，再加权抽 stack 长度并截断到剩余格数；下一个 stack 必须与上一 stack 不同，refill 的首 stack 也必须不同于空格前的 retained symbol；按 wave 取权重，超过数组时沿用末组。
entries.reason: 禁止相邻重复的堆叠生成器是相关抽样，不是独立格子概率表；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Sample symbols and stack lengths by wave, cap lengths to vacancies, reject equal neighboring stacks including the retained refill boundary, and saturate exhausted wave tables; verify adjacent-stack exclusions and resulting symbol frequencies.

entries.mechanism: 普通符号盘填完后按列独立检验 scatter，再在该列均匀选一格覆盖，所以初始盘每列最多一个；cascade 保留已有 scatter，仅在该列有新 refill 格且无 retained scatter 时，从新格中选一格覆盖。
entries.reason: 按列覆盖一个新格并排除已有 scatter 的规则被含保留移动与 wave 截止的 s08#1 完整覆盖。

entries.mechanism: SugarRush 按 base cascade 终盘 scatter 总数达到门槛自然启动 FG，scatter 本身不支付；FG 同样以每 spin 终盘 scatter 总数查 retrigger reward，未达到门槛的配置奖励为零。

entries.mechanism: Scatter meter 到 MAX 即触发（一个/两个 scatter 也可触发）；自然入场按 max(actualScatterCount,3) 查初始 FG 奖励，FG 再触发则只在 meter 到 MAX 时按 actualScatterCount 查 reward，达到 MAX 后不再抽 meter transition。
entries.reason: meter MAX 与实际 count 的两套奖励索引不可合并；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: MAX meter triggers entry even from one/two scatters, indexes natural rounds by max(actualCount,3), but retrigger rewards by actualCount only; stop meter draws once MAX is reached and verify low-count/MAX cases.

entries.mechanism: FG 的下一 cascade 使用按 wave 取值的 dead-spin 基础概率，加上 persistent grid 最大值满足的最后一个 threshold bonus，取上限后抽一次决定是否进入强制 dead-refill；这个 gate 在赢波之后才执行。
entries.reason: persistent grid 反馈的 forced-dead gate 影响 feature 分布。
entries.rule: After a winning wave, combine wave-indexed dead probability with the last satisfied maximum-grid threshold bonus, cap it and sample one forcing gate; verify threshold selection, saturation and no pre-win forcing.

entries.mechanism: Sweety/Candy/Wolf 强制 dead-refill 若 survivors 已能中奖则直接 normal fill；否则从同一 accepted gravity 快照，用单格 stack 重试至无收益；有限预算耗尽改用 normal stack fill；Wolf 每个 rejected attempt 的 column surge 也回滚，仅采用 accepted attempt grid。
entries.reason: 被拒 board 与 column surge 必须一同回滚才能保持契约分布。
entries.rule: If survivors already win, fill normally; otherwise retry single-cell dead refills from one accepted gravity snapshot, restore rejected surge state, and fall back to normal stacks at budget exhaustion, verifying Wolf grid rollback.

entries.mechanism: SugarRush 强制 dead-refill 没有固定原 gravity 快照或 retry budget：每次 rejected winning 候选都把其删除获胜符号后的 gravity 交给下次候选，直到无收益；中间候选不累计支付，也不把其 updated grid 作为新的 persistent grid。
entries.reason: 被拒候选改变下一次 gravity，属不能按普通拒绝采样计算的转移规则。
entries.rule: SugarRush chains rejected winning candidates through their post-removal gravity without paying them or adopting upgraded grids, retrying without a budget; verify this unpaid path-dependent process separately from fixed-snapshot rejection and measure termination.

entries.mechanism: 金额上限按阶段生效：base cascade 完整生成后 clamp 基础奖；若基础已 cap 则直接返回并取消待启动 FG；FG 即使累计奖金已 cap 仍完成全部 pending/追加 spin，最后才 clamp feature，再 clamp base+feature 整轮金额。
entries.reason: 金额 cap 与 feature 终止有分阶段差异；新技能定位：分组舍入、增量信用和多阶段 cap 必须单独讲授，现有 paytable 与 buy 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Generate then cap base cascades, cancel pending free games when base reaches cap, finish all awarded free spins before feature clamping, then cap combined payment; verify capped-base cancellation versus capped-feature continued draws.

entries.mechanism: 初始盘和补格按加权符号、加权堆叠长度逐段生成；相邻堆叠禁止同符号，补格首段也禁止与存留边界符号相同，长度被剩余格数截短。
entries.reason: 加权堆叠、相邻异符号及 retained 边界排除完整重复 s07#0 的堆叠生成规则。

entries.mechanism: Scatter 按列概率覆盖：初始盘每列最多一个；cascade 只有存在新补格且该列没有存留 scatter 才能覆盖一个随机新补格。存留 scatter 保持并随 gravity 移动；模型的 scatterMaxWave 会关闭后续波的覆盖。
entries.reason: 此项包含 wave 停止门与 retained-scatter 生命周期，作为完整 canonical 注入规则；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Overwrite at most one uniformly chosen eligible cell per reel with scatter, retaining existing scatters through gravity; refill requires new cells and no retained scatter, and scatterMaxWave disables later injection, verifying cutoff and retention.

entries.mechanism: Scatter 无随机升级 meter：本次基础 spin 或免费 round 的当前盘总 scatter 达阈值即激活，最终总数索引免费局奖励表；终止的无奖盘同样可触发或再触发，下一免费 round 重新计数。
entries.reason: 无 meter 的直接 threshold 与终盘奖励是独立触发 law；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: MetaStrike activates scatter entry/retrigger on threshold count without a random meter, uses final-board count for awarded rounds including losing terminals, and resets count next free round; verify activation, terminal counts and no carryover.

entries.mechanism: 新方块先按波抽数量，再只从当前没有方块的坐标中均匀不放回抽位置，并按剩余可用坐标截短；可落在 scatter 上，不能重复占同一 overlay 坐标。
entries.reason: overlay 与 underlying symbols 分离的无放回放置规则改变爆炸机会。
entries.rule: Sample new overlay-square count by wave and choose unoccupied overlay coordinates uniformly without replacement, truncating to available cells; scatters remain eligible underlying cells, verifying uniqueness, full overlays and saturation.

entries.mechanism: 炸弹引爆其列内全部方块；每个中心产生自身及上下左右各一格的十字 footprint，排除越界和 scatter 并合并重复格。只消耗真正被炸弹选中的方块，footprint 波及但未被选中的其它方块仍存留。
entries.reason: 爆炸命中集合与被消耗 overlay 集合不同，会影响以后波。
entries.rule: Detonate all selected squares in a bomb’s column, union their orthogonal cross footprints excluding off-board cells and scatters, and consume only selected squares, verifying overlap and unselected squares touched by blasts.

entries.mechanism: 预抽爆炸配额后，每次成功的 detonation event 只消耗一个配额单位，即使同时引爆多个方块；无爆炸尝试不消耗，配额耗尽后可仍发生自然爆炸。
entries.reason: quota 计数单位是事件而非方块，且非硬禁用爆炸；新技能定位：Rush/Chase 的临时与永久档位、scatter 奖励和爆炸 quota 需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能没有足够余量。
entries.rule: Consume one explosion-quota unit per successful detonation event regardless of squares detonated, none on failed attempts, and allow natural explosions after quota exhaustion; verify multi-square events, no-detonation waves and postquota continuation.

entries.mechanism: 金额上限分阶段生效：基础 cascade 完整生成后截断基础奖，若基础已达上限则直接结束并不再启动已触发免费局；免费局即使累计奖已达上限也执行全部 pending/追加局，再截断 feature 奖；最终基础加 feature 再受整轮上限约束。
entries.reason: base、feature 与 whole-round cap 及 pending-spin 执行顺序完整重复 s07#7。

entries.mechanism: coins 按每列均匀 stop 抽取环绕连续三格，落到普通币或特殊币再按阶段的权重表抽金额；同列格子来自同一 strip window，并非独立抽格。
entries.reason: 在 strip 相关性之外此项还规定 phase 决定币值抽样；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Sample each reel’s contiguous circular coin window from one uniform stop, then draw normal/special values using the active phase table; verify strip correlation and phase-specific money draws rather than independent cells.

entries.mechanism: coins 的 payline 实际只接受全 Wild，或恰好一个非 Wild 且无 Coin 的三格线；nonWildSymbols 是保留重复项的数组，因此普通同符三连和一 Wild 加两普通同符均不支付。
entries.reason: 看似 bespoke 的实现仍是直接决定现金的 evaluator 规则，应限定游戏名讲授；新技能定位：全 wild、多连通组和实现偏差需要明确的现金评估规则，math-lines-ways-cluster 仅剩 1 词。
entries.rule: Coins pays three-cell lines only when all are wild or exactly one array element is nonwild and no coin appears; duplicate ordinary symbols still count separately, verifying rejected ordinary triples and accepted two-wild lines.

entries.mechanism: coins 只有总 Coin 数达到触发门槛且至少含一个特殊收集币才进入 feature；普通币单独满足数量仍不触发，触发时保留并首先收集该 triggering board。
entries.reason: 数量和 collector 双门共同限定 feature 入口；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: Enter Coins feature only when total coin count reaches threshold and includes a special collector; retain and collect the triggering board first, verifying normal-only threshold boards and first collection counted once.

entries.mechanism: coins 通常任何新普通币或特殊币都会把剩余 respins 重设；达到总 horizon 的最后三次后，无论是否落新币都只递减，仍正常抽币并收集，不是强制空转；到 counter 耗尽或总 horizon 停止。
entries.reason: horizon 最后阶段仍抽币但禁 reset，影响 feature 时长和奖；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: New Coins landings reset respins until the horizon’s last three turns, when every turn decrements regardless of landings while sampling and collecting normally; stop on counter or horizon, verifying late-arrival payment without reset.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp 跨 paid main 只携带固定 Sticky Coin 坐标；拒绝重复、越界、超上限及完整 middle row。未触发时按固定遍历顺序填空格，一达到 sticky 上限即移除后续抽表的 sticky 项；若 middle row 意外填满，均匀删一个本轮新格，并同时撤销其 sticky carry。触发后和购买后不输出 carry。
entries.reason: cross-paid carry 的资格及失败后修正会改变长期触发概率；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: CoinUp carries only valid sticky coordinates, suppresses further sticky draws once capped, and repairs a full middle row by uniformly deleting a new cell and its carry; triggering/bought rounds return no carry, verifying all exclusions.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp natural bonus 初板仅包含已携带 Sticky 与强制填满的 middle row，其他未 carry 的格均为空；buy 的初板清空 carry 并从各自 start 表强制 middle row。初板上的每个 collector 随即收集，随后才进入 bonus。
entries.reason: 初板构造与立即收集决定自然和买入的奖励分布；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: Natural CoinUp starts with carried sticky coins plus a forced middle row and otherwise empties, while buys discard carry and use their start tables; collect each starting collector before bonus, verifying entry distributions and payment order.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp 进入 bonus 时只抽一次 hidden tier，此后整个 feature 的所有空格 landing 与 UP-row 抽取一直使用这一 tier 的两个表，不能每次 respin 或每格重抽 tier。
entries.reason: 共享 tier 是整段 feature 的隐状态，不能逐格独立重抽；新技能定位：独立 strip、相关窗口、堆叠和特殊符号抽样属于服务端概率模型，现有渲染技能不承接且数学技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Sample CoinUp’s hidden tier once at bonus entry and use its landing and UP tables throughout the feature; verify that neither cells nor respins redraw the tier and that joint outcomes preserve dependence.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp collector 只在初板出现或本轮新落下时收集一次：把所有其他非 collector 格当时的 value × mult 求和写入自身 value，不反复更新旧 collector；该 sweep 在本轮 UP 前完成，collector 自身 mult 留到最终付款再乘。
entries.reason: collector 采集倍率与自身终盘倍率是不同阶段；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: Only newly appearing CoinUp collectors sweep other noncollector values times multipliers once before UP; store that sum and apply the collector’s own multiplier only at final payment, verifying old collectors and newly landed cells.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp Multi UP 在该列本轮 landings/collectors 完成后，给当前所有非空格永久增加 multiUpStep，包括刚落的 coin、collector、jackpot、未开 mystery；空格不预存 multiplier，之后落下的新格仍从 1 开始。
entries.reason: 永久 cell multiplier 与未来 landing multiplier 需要分开；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: After column landings and collectors, Multi UP permanently adds multiUpStep to all occupied cells including mysteries; empty cells retain no increment and later arrivals start at one, verifying collector-before-UP and empty-cell behavior.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp Coin UP 只升级该列当前 coin 格一阶，重新把 coin value 设为新 level；顶级 Sticky Coin 的下一次升级转成零值 mysteryJackpot，同时保留 mult。Jackpot、collector 和 mystery 不会被 Coin UP 升级。
entries.reason: 升级后的 zero mystery 和保留倍率会改变终盘支付；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: Coin UP advances existing ordinary coins one level, resets their face value, and converts top sticky coins into zero-value mystery jackpots while preserving multipliers; exclude other types and verify repeat upgrades and reveal eligibility.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp buySuperBonus 每轮先照常抽三个 UP；若未抽出任何 multiUp，则从 none 的列中均匀挑一列替成 multiUp；若三列全是 coinUp，则从所有列均匀挑一列替换。已有 multiUp 时不额外添加。
entries.reason: 保证 modifier 的条件替换与直接独立追加不是同一分布；新技能定位：免费局触发优先级、共享隐藏状态和跨局升级需要独立状态规则，现有 cascade 技能仅剩 2 词。
entries.rule: Superbonus first samples normal UPs, then if no Multi UP exists replaces one uniformly selected none column, or any column when all are Coin UP; verify repair distribution and no extra Multi UP when present.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp bonus 结束才逐格开启 mystery：mysteryJackpot 只抽固定 jackpot 类型，普通 mystery 使用可含普通 coin、jackpot 或 collector 的独立 reveal 表；全部保留原格 mult，新揭示 collector 在全部揭示后再收集。
entries.reason: 终盘统一 reveal 的顺序及类型表决定 collector sources；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: Reveal mysteries only at bonus end using separate jackpot-only and general tables, preserve each multiplier, then collect all newly revealed collectors after the entire reveal batch; verify table eligibility and simultaneous revelations.

entries.mechanism: CoinUp mystery 揭成 collector 时，收集 pool 排除所有原本为 mystery/mysteryJackpot 的坐标，即使其现已揭成普通 coin 或 jackpot；也排除其他 collector。因此不会收集同一终局 reveal 批次的奖励。
entries.reason: 按原始角色而非揭示后角色排除 source，是支付规则；新技能定位：跨 paid carry、UP 和终盘 mystery 需要完整保留状态规则，collector 与现有 hold-and-win 的余量不足。
entries.rule: A mystery-revealed collector excludes every originally mysterious coordinate and all other collectors, even when those mysteries now show ordinary rewards; verify that no reward from the same reveal batch enters its pool.

entries.mechanism: Bars 每格 multiplier/count 先量化，所选倍率合计再量化，最后 bet×合计再次量化；不是只对 bet×原始 reward 合计/count 舍入一次。
entries.reason: 逐格、求和、乘 stake 三层量化改变实际支付；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: Bars uses toFixed(12) for each tile multiplier/count, then toFixed(8) for the selected multiplier sum and stake times that sum; verify intermediate boundaries rather than one final aggregate rounding.

entries.mechanism: Hotdeck normal 抽一个均匀 strip stop，highRisk 独立有放回抽多个 stop；只有每个 drawn color 都等于选定 pick 才支付一次，否则支付零。
entries.reason: compound all-match 与单抽不是可互换的中奖事件。
entries.rule: Hotdeck normal draws one uniform strip stop; highRisk draws multiple stops independently with replacement and pays once only if every color equals the pick, verifying all-match probability and any-mismatch zero return.

entries.mechanism: PrimeDice 以互不重叠区间宽度之和计价，区间接触同一端点允许；实际未舍入 uniform roll 落入任一闭区间即中奖，区间外为零。
entries.reason: 连续宽度计价与整数源闭区间命中必须分别核对。
entries.rule: Price PrimeDice by the sum of nonoverlapping interval widths, allowing shared endpoints, and test the raw unrounded uniform roll against their closed union; verify touching intervals, gaps and finite-source endpoint mass.

entries.mechanism: PrimeDice 先量化总区间宽度，再量化 targetRTP×100/chance 的报价倍率并施加 cap，最终中奖金额再次量化；显示 result 的量化不参与中奖判断。
entries.reason: 报价和结果显示的舍入具有不同经济作用；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: PrimeDice uses toFixed(8) for total interval width, targetRTP×100/chance before multiplier cap, and winning stake×multiplier; displayed result rounding never determines eligibility, verifying chance, quote, cap and raw-roll endpoint boundaries.

entries.mechanism: RingOfFortune 接受 component stake 总和与 charged bet 在绝对容差内不相等的下注，随后仍按未重新归一化的 winning-color stake 付款。
entries.reason: 组件与总 debit 不等仍付款是金额准入风险，需确认该容差是否为应保留的产品合同；新技能定位：逐票、逐手与最坏 gross liability 的准入上限需要独立规则，现有 wallet/live 技能接近上限。
entries.rule: RingOfFortune accepts allocation sums within an absolute 0.01 tolerance of charged stake and pays the winning color’s unnormalized allocation; verify mismatch-induced stake-dependent RTP before adopting this legacy admission contract.

entries.mechanism: Tarot 先对 gold×silver1×silver2 的倍率乘积作最近舍入，再对 bet×该已量化倍率作第二次最近舍入；不是只量化最后金额。
entries.reason: 乘积倍率预量化不能替换为最终金额舍入；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: Tarot applies toFixed(8) to the product of its three card multipliers, then again to stake times that result; verify intermediate multiplier boundaries and the resulting paid RTP.

entries.mechanism: CircuitSnap 必须从 power 相邻格起步，路径在 grid 内正交相邻且不重复，终点为 bulb，首 bulb 前及两 bulb 间必须有 rod，并遵守 rod/bulb 上限；服务端由合法 path 导出 prefix rod counts，不能信 client pattern。

entries.rule: Validate CircuitSnap’s orthogonally adjacent nonrepeating in-grid path from power to bulb, require rods before/between bulbs and enforce counts, then derive rod-count prefixes server-side; verify illegal paths cannot supply client-priced patterns.

entries.mechanism: Deck52行列同时完成时按completedRows×rowPayout + completedColumns×colPayout相加，同一格可同时支持行奖和列奖；不是取最大一项或单线付款。
entries.reason: 行列奖重叠仍累加，是标准 occupancy 奖励机制。
entries.rule: Deck52 adds completedRows×rowPayout and completedColumns×columnPayout, allowing a cell to support both awards; verify simultaneous row/column completion rather than paying only the maximum or one line.

entries.mechanism: HIT Draw cash在抽样前检查每一个潜在结果：下注必须使倍率乘法可精确整除，所得win须整除currencyUnit且不超过maxExposure；任一个结果不满足便拒绝整笔开包，不能先抽后舍入或压cap。
entries.reason: 所有候选 outcome 的可支付性必须在 RNG 前成立，不能抽后舍入或压 cap；新技能定位：逐票、逐手与最坏 gross liability 的准入上限需要独立规则，现有 wallet/live 技能接近上限。
entries.rule: Before HIT Draw sampling, require every possible outcome’s stake×multiplier to divide exactly, land on currencyUnit and stay within exposure; reject the whole opening on any failure, verifying rejected draws consume no RNG.

entries.mechanism: 实物奖数量采用两阶段不同舍入：先referenceMicroUsd=halfUp(stakeMicroUsd×referenceValueMultiplierPpm/PPM)，再quantityNanograms=floor(referenceMicroUsd×10^9/lockedAskMicroUsdPerGram)；纯度单独记录，不进入这个数量公式。
entries.reason: 实物价值和数量的两阶段舍入可转移到同类 prize pack；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: Compute reference microUSD with half-up(stakeMicroUSD×multiplierPPM/10⁶), then floor(referenceMicroUSD×10⁹/lockedAskMicroUSDPerGram) for nanograms; record purity separately, and verify both rounding boundaries plus the immutable price lock.

entries.mechanism: Plinko只有risk=insane才启用随机ball multiplier并消费第二次draw；low/medium/high固定ball=1、仅消费bucket draw。
entries.reason: 随机 draw 消耗和 ball 分布是 mode 行为而非 risk 标签配置。
entries.rule: Only insane Plinko risk consumes a second draw for random ball multiplier; low/medium/high use ball one with only the bucket draw, verifying risk-specific RNG transcripts and compound payout distributions.

entries.mechanism: legacy crash autobet返回首项wins[0]作为绝对win，代码未乘bet；因此合法不同下注得到相同货币返回，声明maxWin也直接作用在wins数值上。
entries.reason: 代码确认未乘 stake，但需确认旧 autobet 是否仍是应纳入技能覆盖的可达生产路线；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: Legacy crash autobet returns wins[0] as an absolute capped amount without multiplying by stake; verify stake-scaling and realized RTP explicitly before transferring any multiplier-based pricing formula to this route.

entries.mechanism: RPS autobet用pattern长度作为结算期限，只要没有loss就付最后currentPayout；首tie建立T×bet，因此短于最大hand数的全tie pattern也能立即得到T×bet。
entries.reason: autobet horizon 和 first-tie claim 改变可达终局奖；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: RPS autobet terminates at pattern length, pays the current claim if no loss, and establishes targetRTP×stake on a first tie; verify short all-tie patterns separately from interactive first-tie cashout rejection.

entries.mechanism: Moles每轮重新均匀抽k个不同目标洞，选择洞在molePositions中才算hit和生存，概率k/7；不是避免目标。
entries.reason: 成功事件是命中而非避开，可用于明确条件 survival law；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Each Moles round samples k distinct holes uniformly and survives only when the chosen hole contains a mole, giving k/7 success; verify fresh-round sampling and hit-versus-avoid semantics.

entries.mechanism: Snakes每轮两颗独立公平六面骰，以和数索引该difficulty/round的factor；factor>0才生存，并乘入上一轮累计倍率（逐步八位舍入）；任一零factor灭绝，cashout/末轮付累计乘积×bet。
entries.reason: dice-sum factors 决定条件生存和累计奖，不属于蛇移动仿真；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Roll two independent fair d6 each Snakes round, index its difficulty/round factor by their sum, and round8 the cumulative product on positive factors; zero terminates, verifying cashout and final stake-scaled payment.

entries.mechanism: Floor13 Cursed floor在基础monster数上增加一个monster，仅仍有safe门的难度可抽；这一floor使用Cursed对应增长因子。
entries.reason: 增加 hazard 并配对增长因子是标准风险 feature 变体；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Cursed adds one monster to the base floor only when at least one safe door remains, then uses the Cursed growth factor; verify eligible difficulties and changed safe-door survival probability.

entries.mechanism: Floor13 Blessed仅monster≥2时可抽，均匀揭示其中一个monster门，该门不可选；safe门数不变而可选门数减少，再按Blessed因子增长claim。
entries.reason: 揭示危险门改变可选空间，不能只改展示或沿用原概率；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Blessed requires at least two monsters, uniformly reveals one monster as unselectable, preserves the safe count, and applies Blessed growth; verify that survival uses remaining selectable doors rather than the original denominator.

entries.mechanism: Floor13 Blackout强制一次选择两扇不同且未揭示的门，只有两者均safe才成功；不足两safe门的难度禁抽Blackout，用双选对应因子结算一次slot。
entries.reason: 双选无放回与一次因子是可复用 ladder feature；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Blackout requires two distinct unrevealed selections and succeeds only when both are safe, is disabled below two safe doors, and applies one double-pick factor; verify nonreplacement probability and single-slot consumption.

entries.mechanism: Floor13全run的Cursed/Blackout共用specialBudget；达到次数后后续抽样直接排除这两条概率带，不重归一化剩余权重，因此Blessed/plain分布随history改变。
entries.reason: 有限事件预算和 residual mass 影响下一 floor 的概率；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Cursed/Blackout share a run-wide special budget; after exhaustion remove their probability bands without renormalizing remaining weights, leaving residual plain outcomes, and verify history-dependent event probabilities and eligibility gates.

entries.mechanism: Crucifix 只救一次 monster hit，当前 value 乘 saveKeep、消耗一个 slot、该 slot 不乘 growth，之后切成 uninsured factor。
entries.reason: 保险的 haircut、slot 消耗和未来定价需要完整状态；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Crucifix saves only the first monster hit, multiplies current value by saveKeep, consumes one slot without growth, and switches future factors to uninsured; verify saved-hit versus true-safe transitions.

entries.mechanism: Floor13只有最后slot真实safe才能进入Basement，付款为value/E[bonus]×预抽bonus×totalStake；最后slot靠保险救命则直接付haircut后的value，不获bonus。
entries.reason: 终局 bonus 与保险救命互斥，会改变实际 EV；新技能定位：保险、揭门、双选与特殊事件预算改变条件生存概率，现有 ladder 技能仅余 18 词。
entries.rule: Only a truly safe final slot receives Basement value/expectedBonus×sampledBonus×totalStake; an insurance-saved final slot pays haircut value directly, verifying bonus eligibility and expectation normalization.

entries.rule: Floor13 autobet replaces a Blessed revealed-door preference with the lowest unrevealed door, adds the lowest second Blackout door, continues after insurance saves, and banks on schedule exhaustion; verify legal fallback and manual parity.

entries.mechanism: Floor13 cashout即使尚未pick也接受，但已付opening stake不返还、win=0；abandonment调用同一cashout，不替玩家开门。
entries.reason: 零动作弃局的本金归属是结算机制；新技能定位：自动玩法与弃局默认策略改变实际结算，现有 instant 和 minigame 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Floor13 accepts cashout before any pick but returns zero rather than opening stake; abandonment uses this same cashout without playing a door, verifying funded zero-action closure and no involuntary risk.

entries.mechanism: Flip/RPS/Snakes弃局时只要continue仍可用就自动继续风险，直到终止；Flip固定heads、RPS固定rock，Snakes无决策。
entries.reason: 弃局自动承担风险与立即 cashout 有不同金额分布；新技能定位：自动玩法与弃局默认策略改变实际结算，现有 instant 和 minigame 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: On abandonment Flip/RPS/Snakes continue risk while continuation remains legal, using heads/rock or no choice respectively until terminal; verify the resulting path and payout rather than substituting immediate banking.

entries.mechanism: Pepe/Pump弃局根据当前绝对货币currentPayout>1.5选择takeWin，否则continue；阈值作用于金额而非倍率，因此弃局策略随bet改变。
entries.reason: 按绝对金额决策的弃局策略具有 stake 依赖；新技能定位：自动玩法与弃局默认策略改变实际结算，现有 instant 和 minigame 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Pepe/Pump abandonment banks only when current absolute currency payout exceeds 1.5, otherwise continues; verify multiple stake sizes to ensure the threshold is not interpreted as a return multiplier.

entries.mechanism: Moles/GoalStreak/PartyPong/PolarMines弃局先bank合法claim；未取得首次success且仅能continue时自动执行第一次pick/throw，然后再bank或fail；默认pick/aim=0。
entries.reason: 无 claim 时的默认一次风险是明确的产品状态规则；新技能定位：自动玩法与弃局默认策略改变实际结算，现有 instant 和 minigame 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Moles/GoalStreak/PartyPong/PolarMines abandonment banks a legal claim; before first success it executes the first available pick/throw at zero, then banks or fails, verifying one forced opening risk and terminal closure.

entries.mechanism: liability cap 取 stake 相对上限、绝对金额上限与平台 maxExposure 的最小值并向 wallet grid 下取整；开局必须覆盖 N 倍 stake，继续只有 pot≤floor(cap/N) 才能开放全部风险方向，否则成功后直接支付余额。
entries.reason: 完整方向的最坏 gross liability 决定 continue 资格；新技能定位：逐票、逐手与最坏 gross liability 的准入上限需要独立规则，现有 wallet/live 技能接近上限。
entries.rule: Floor the minimum of relative cap, absolute cap and exposure to wallet grid; require opening liability N×stake, allow all risks only while pot≤floor(cap/N), otherwise pay after success, verifying boundary admission without clipping wins.

entries.mechanism: 分别计数风险选择和全部牌 draw：保证移动仅增加 totalDraws；获胜后任一计数达到其 horizon 即 forcedCashout 全部舍入后余额，风险上限优先于 draw 上限。
entries.reason: 两种 horizon 计数关系决定强制终止与 RNG 使用；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Count risky choices and all draws separately, incrementing only draws for guaranteed moves; after success cash out rounded balance when either horizon is reached, prioritizing risk-limit reason, verifying guaranteed-only paths and simultaneous limits.

entries.mechanism: Kiln 成功 stretch 对 multiplier product 向下取整，再在 setDown 对 stake×haul 向下取整；这两层 floor 属于游戏金额规则，不能替换为最近舍入或只在最后舍入。
entries.reason: 逐步与终盘双层 floor 会降低实际 return；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: Kiln floors haul×stretch factor after each successful stretch, then floors stake×haul on setDown; verify two-stage downward rounding at minimal stakes and do not replace it with nearest rounding or one final floor.

entries.mechanism: Kiln 达最大 stretch 数或 tMax<tMin 后只允许 setDown；manual 成功不立即 auto-bank，autobet 则在固定 target 不再合法时提早 bank，zero gather 不进入风险阶段。
entries.reason: 合法动作集及 manual/autobet 终止政策影响停时；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Kiln permits only setDown at maximum stretches or tMax<tMin; manual success does not auto-bank, autobet banks when its target becomes illegal, and zero gather never enters risk, verifying mode-specific stopping.

entries.mechanism: SniperRange 实际用距离线性缩放 sigma 的 Rayleigh 半径 r=sigma×sqrt(-2 ln(max(u,MIN_VALUE)))；以严格 r<bandRadius 确定 bull/inner/edge，否则 miss，绝不按四舍五入后的公布 probability 表抽环。
entries.reason: Rayleigh 半径是实际现金 outcome mapper，通用 inverse-CDF 不能用展示概率替代。
entries.rule: Sample SniperRange radius as distance-scaled σ√(−2ln(max(u,MIN_VALUE))), compare strict radius thresholds to select the paid ring, and verify finite-source boundaries rather than sampling rounded public probabilities.

entries.mechanism: SniperRange 每次 shot 都消耗一发；miss 直接终局，最后一发 hit 或所有 station 被 cap 排除时主动 bank；autobet 若预选 station 被 cap 排除也 bank，即使别的 station 仍可选。
entries.reason: 弹数与 cap 的 stopping 规则是赌局状态而非武器仿真；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Each SniperRange shot consumes ammunition, misses terminate, and last-hit or no-legal-station states bank; autobet banks if its selected station is excluded even when others remain, verifying cap-driven action removal.

entries.mechanism: SniperRange 每次 hit 先对 potMultiplier×step 做最近舍入，再在 bank 对 potMultiplier×stake 再舍入；公布 odds 的 rounding 不参与 money。
entries.reason: 公布 odds 与真实累计 multiplier 舍入应分别核对；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: SniperRange uses toFixed(8) for potMultiplier×hitStep at each hit and again for potMultiplier×stake when banking; public odds rounding never drives payouts, and verify intermediate-product and final-money boundaries.

entries.mechanism: Twist 的 at-risk 金额是每个 color 已达 level 以下所有 rung award 的前缀和，再跨 green/orange/purple 相加；cashOutAll 将它与已 secured bonuses 相加后一次兑现，普通 advance 本身不支付。
entries.reason: prefix claim 与 secured balance 是不同的现金状态；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Twist’s at-risk claim sums every award prefix below each achieved color level; cashOutAll adds secured bonuses and pays once, while ordinary advances credit nothing, verifying multi-color prefixes and deferred payment.

entries.mechanism: Twist colored gem 未达顶级时只提升该色一级；已在顶级再中同色时立即 secure bonus 并将该色降到 max−1，别色不变；purple 顶级额外独立加权抽 mystery bonus 后同样降一级。
entries.reason: 顶级同色命中提款并回退是可复用 accumulating ladder 规则；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: A colored gem advances its color once until the top; another top-color hit secures bonus and drops that color one level, with purple sampling a weighted mystery, verifying other colors remain unchanged.

entries.mechanism: Twist skull 同时使三色 level 各减一且下限为零，不扣 secured bonus；当全部 level 为零时关闭回合并支付仅剩 secured bonus，包括开局 dark/skull 形成的零回合。
entries.reason: 局部可失奖与已保全奖在同一 loss event 下不同处理；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Skull reduces every Twist color level by one to zero without reducing secured bonuses; all-zero levels terminate and pay secured value only, including zero-action dark/skull starts, verifying partial-loss and terminal branches.

entries.mechanism: Twist dark 保持各 level 与 secured balance 不变，但仍消耗一次 roll horizon；达到 roll horizon 的 surviving board 自动 secure 全部 at-risk 后，加上既有 banked 再做 stake×maxWin 总额 cap 结算。
entries.reason: 不改变 board 的 idle 事件仍消耗 horizon 并影响兑现时点；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Dark preserves levels and secured balances but consumes a roll; a surviving horizon banks all at-risk value plus secured bonuses before the stake-relative total cap, verifying idle draws and horizon/cap ordering.

entries.mechanism: Twist 每次 bonus 加入 bankedWin 时先最近舍入，cashout/终局将 secured 与剩余 at-risk 相加再舍入，随后乘原 stake 做最近舍入并取 stake 相对 cap 的最小值。
entries.reason: banked 累计和最终 stake scaling 的舍入位置都影响金额；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: Twist uses toFixed(8) for each secured-bonus addition, secured-plus-at-risk termination total, and stake scaling before applying its stake-relative cap; verify staged boundaries and bonus-only terminal states.

entries.mechanism: 开局每一列各 row 从该 row 允许 block kinds 独立均匀抽取，再每列独立均匀抽一个 chest；layout/chest 一次冻结并在开局 opening digs 后公开给后续 dig/bank 决策。
entries.reason: 公开且冻结的布局决定后续可优化的信息集；新技能定位：dig frontier、可见布局和报价 cadence 是可转移的奖励状态机，现有 conditional-value 技能仅余 53 词。
entries.rule: Sample each layout cell uniformly from its row’s allowed kinds and each column chest independently once, freeze the layout, and expose it after opening digs; verify later decisions never reroll or hide already-public state.

entries.mechanism: preDugRows 直接把初始 frontier 下移到预挖行之后，那些跳过 blocks 的 pay 永不收集；尚未 cleared 的 chest 也不因跳行提前获得。
entries.reason: 预挖初态不等于已赚奖励，是奖励状态定义；新技能定位：dig frontier、可见布局和报价 cadence 是可转移的奖励状态机，现有 conditional-value 技能仅余 53 词。
entries.rule: Move initial frontier past preDugRows without collecting skipped block rewards or uncleared chests; verify predug state against an actually cleared state so free progress cannot create cash rewards.

entries.mechanism: 每次 dig 为各列独立抽 reel cells；同列 picks 的 hits 相加，blank/enhance 自身不打 hits；存在 enhance 时每个同列 pick 变为 max(自身 hits,target hits)，不升级其他列且不降级更强 pick。
entries.reason: 列内增强与命中叠加决定实际奖励转移；新技能定位：dig frontier、可见布局和报价 cadence 是可转移的奖励状态机，现有 conditional-value 技能仅余 53 词。
entries.rule: Sample dig cells independently per column, sum pick hits, and let enhance raise each same-column pick to max(own,target) without hits itself or cross-column effects; verify multiple picks and stronger-pick preservation.

entries.mechanism: hits 只从当前 frontier 顶向下消耗 durability，未破块剩余 durability 跨 dig 保留，破块剩余 hits 继续打下一块；每块实际破坏才获对应 pay，runeBlock 此刻额外抽 weighted prize。
entries.reason: durability 和 frontier 是计算状态价值的必要充分状态；新技能定位：dig frontier、可见布局和报价 cadence 是可转移的奖励状态机，现有 conditional-value 技能仅余 53 词。
entries.rule: Consume hits from the current frontier downward, persist remaining durability, spill surplus into following blocks, and award only broken blocks including weighted rune prizes; verify partial hits, multi-block spill and exact-once rewards.

entries.mechanism: firestone 破坏后向该列刚成为 frontier 的下一 block 追加 blast damage，与常规剩余 pick hits 叠加；现有布局只软化该块，不能跨列、穿透更深块或触发可达链式破坏。
entries.reason: 额外伤害作用域限制可防止错误的奖励链；新技能定位：dig frontier、可见布局和报价 cadence 是可转移的奖励状态机，现有 conditional-value 技能仅余 53 词。
entries.rule: A broken firestone adds blast damage only to the next frontier block in its column alongside remaining hits; verify no cross-column, deeper-block or unreachable chain rewards under the current layout.

entries.mechanism: resolved dig 后 value=0 立即 over/零支付；达到 chosen-dig horizon 或 E[deltaV]=0 则强制 bank 全部 current value，只有正 value 且仍有增量机会才继续。
entries.reason: 强制 bank 的价值与零值终止需要区别；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: After each resolved dig, zero value ends unpaid, decision horizon or zero expected increment banks the complete current value, otherwise continuation requires positive value/opportunity; verify exhausted states alongside the separately defined cap branch.

entries.mechanism: mode charged stake 在 baseBetOf 中除 modeCost 后向 currency units 下取整，余数不进入 payout basis；正 stake 若 baseBet 变零则开局拒绝，mode 除法不采用 exact fractional inner stake。
entries.reason: modeCost 后 inner stake 下取整改变实际 charged-stake RTP；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: DeepDelve floors charged mode stake divided by modeCost to 10⁻⁸ currency units, excludes the remainder from payout basis, and rejects a positive stake producing zero base bet; verify division-grid and tiny-stake boundaries.

entries.mechanism: bank 将 multiplier H-value 先向整数 H 下取整，与原 baseBet units 相乘后除100向 currency units 下取整；不是钱包最后统一最近舍入。
entries.reason: H-value 的预 floor 和 currency floor 是两个独立支付规则；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: DeepDelve floors H-value to an integer, multiplies original base-bet units, then floors division by 100 to 10⁻⁸ currency units; verify both floor boundaries rather than nearest final wallet rounding.

entries.mechanism: 只有普通 non-bonus direct win>0 才进入 gamble/bank 状态；lucky bonus 不论总 bonusWin 多大都直接支付并终局，不可赌 bonus。
entries.reason: gamble 资格按奖的来源而非仅金额决定；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Only positive ordinary nonbonus wins enter gamble/bank; lucky bonuses settle immediately regardless of size and cannot be gambled, verifying bonus-versus-direct route eligibility including zero outcomes.

entries.mechanism: 正确 gamble 在未达到 maxGambleRounds 时只更新 pending 而不支付，可继续 bank/gamble；达到 round horizon 的正确猜测自动 bank，eligibility 不因 stake 规模或货币 ceiling 改变。
entries.reason: 延迟支付与 horizon auto-bank 是标准 double-up 状态规则；新技能定位：secured 与 at-risk 余额、动作期限和强制兑现决定停时价值，现有 conditional-value 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Successful FruitMachine gambles update pending winnings without paying until bank or the configured last gamble, when success auto-banks; verify round-horizon closure independent of stake size and absent currency-ceiling gating.

entries.mechanism: banker factor 按 round/offerRounds 从 offerBase 线性增加 f=clamp(offerBase+(1−offerBase)×min(round,offerRounds)/offerRounds,0,1)，再乘 mean(unopened)×stake；只教 final factor=1 无法确定中间实际报价。
entries.reason: 线性 banker factor 的实际公式补足只说明最终公平的现有技能。
entries.rule: Quote factor f=clamp(offerBase+(1−offerBase)×min(round,offerRounds)/offerRounds,0,1), multiplied by mean unopened value×stake; verify intermediate offers and the final fair factor with the kept plate still included.

entries.mechanism: kept plate 永不允许 openCase，已揭 plate 不能再开；每 round 必须先达到 opens quota 才出 offer，pending offer 阻止继续 open；noDeal 消耗 offer 并 round+1、reset opens counter，之后才允许再开。
entries.reason: offer FSM 的 cadence 与 item 资格决定可达策略；新技能定位：dig frontier、可见布局和报价 cadence 是可转移的奖励状态机，现有 conditional-value 技能仅余 53 词。
entries.rule: Never reveal kept or already-open plates, issue offers only after each round’s opening quota, block reveals while offers await, and advance/reset quota only after noDeal; verify every illegal cadence transition.

entries.mechanism: computeOffer 对 raw factor×mean×stake 先最近舍入再取绝对 currency cap；最终 kept reveal 同样先最近舍入再取绝对 currency cap，因此最小 stake 与 cap stake 的实付金额不由纯 mean/offerFactor 决定。
entries.reason: 绝对 cap 与最近舍入会破坏名义 offer value；新技能定位：倍率量化、钱包网格、实物数量与报价舍入不能由一次最终舍入替代，现有 money 技能仅余 30 词。
entries.rule: Round raw banker offers and final kept-reveal money first, then apply the absolute currency cap; verify minimum-stake and capped-stake EV rather than relying only on unrounded means or factors.

entries.mechanism: abandoned round 若已有 banker offer 则接受 deal；否则自动依序打开尚未揭示的非 kept plate，直到出 offer/terminal，不采用始终 noDeal 以取得 headline ceiling 的策略。
entries.reason: 弃局策略不同于数学最高收益策略，需要具体实现；新技能定位：自动玩法与弃局默认策略改变实际结算，现有 instant 和 minigame 技能余量不足。
entries.rule: Abandoned deal games accept a pending offer; otherwise open the next unrevealed nonkept plate until an offer or terminal, verifying ordered selection and realized return rather than assuming always-no-deal ceiling strategy.

entries.mechanism: main 的 handBets 必须与座位数一致、逐手位于钱包网格、每个非零座位满足平台最低下注且总和严格等于 aggregate bet；零下注座位不发牌也不参与结算。
entries.reason: 多手下注分配与总 debit 精确相等是准入和结算基础；新技能定位：逐票、逐手与最坏 gross liability 的准入上限需要独立规则，现有 wallet/live 技能接近上限。
entries.rule: Require one wallet-grid handBet per seat, each nonzero stake above platform minimum and their exact sum equal to aggregate debit; inactive zero-stake seats receive no cards or settlement, verifying mixed active layouts.

entries.mechanism: 每个付费续步的最低金额同时受原网格和当前网格约束；最高金额取原 main、当前 main 及显式正 maxBonusBet 的最小值，省略或零 maxBonusBet 不额外限缩；当前 exposure 只能把已保存 ceiling 收紧。
entries.reason: 续步必须交集原始与当前约束，不能放宽已接受 exposure；新技能定位：逐票、逐手与最坏 gross liability 的准入上限需要独立规则，现有 wallet/live 技能接近上限。
entries.rule: Paid continuations satisfy original and current minimum grids, cap stake by original/current main and positive explicit bonus maxima, and only tighten saved exposure ceilings; verify omitted/zero bonus limits and changed platform limits.

entries.mechanism: 开局按逐手自然牌最大 gross return 之和检查 exposure；付费 Double/Split 按变更后的全部子手布局再次计算最坏 payable return，bust/inactive 为零、Surrender 与自然牌分别计价，超限拒绝而非截断结算。
entries.reason: layout 变化后的全部子手最坏 return 需要重新做准入；新技能定位：逐票、逐手与最坏 gross liability 的准入上限需要独立规则，现有 wallet/live 技能接近上限。
entries.rule: Check summed maximum gross returns before opening and again after Double/Split topology changes, valuing naturals/surrenders separately and bust/inactive hands zero; reject overexposure without clipping settlement, verifying all child-hand liabilities.

entries.mechanism: 每个新 round 重新创建完整牌鞋；翻开一张 burnCard，按其 Blackjack 点数（Ace 为 1、十值牌为 10）再弃去该数量的额外牌，然后才发初始牌。
